pt-remittances.g: PT deducted vs paid to the state, month by month
pt-remittances.w: Three totals — PT deducted from employees (completed payroll), PT paid (challans uploaded) and the balance still to pay — and one row per wage month, company and state: PT registration number, employees, gross wages, PT to be paid (payroll), paid, balance, paid-on date and challan number. PT is a state levy, so the state is the employee's branch state (the company's state when the branch has none). The template lists every active employee with the month's wages, PT and state already filled from the completed payroll; HR adds the challan details and uploads. A line counts as paid once its paid-on date is filled.
